sentence: At 375px, a long unbroken bed name makes the watering tables on /waterings and the dashboard wider than the viewport, causing horizontal scrolling.
evidence: Signed in as the demo user and created a bed whose name was 60 'A' characters with no spaces (60 is the maximum the schema allows). Recorded a 12.5 L watering for it through POST /api/waterings, then loaded the pages at a 375x800 viewport. On /waterings, document.documentElement.scrollWidth was 869 against a clientWidth of 375, and the table was 836px wide. On the dashboard (/), scrollWidth was 784 and the Recent waterings table was 751px wide. Both pages scroll sideways. main.css has no overflow-wrap or word-break rules, and neither table sits in a scroll container. A gardener's own bed name breaks the mobile layout of both new watering views. Afterwards I deleted the test bed.
